title: Multi-Output Machine Learning for Prediction of Postoperative Outcomes After Cardiac Surgery Using Patient Blood Management Biomarkers.
summary: A decision-tree regressor predicted multiple postoperative cardiac-surgery outcomes using patient blood-management and clinical variables. The paper reports held-out evaluation across five random states but only 513 complete cases from a 1,414-patient source cohort; authors describe proof of concept requiring external validation.
